subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by a larger fixed Control UI history batch, or should closure require older-message pagination using the existing chat.history paging contract?
rationale: Current main confirms both the 100-message cap and the backend paging support, but docs intentionally describe a bounded recent window for stability, so maintainers need to choose the UX/performance tradeoff.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this issue only after Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand with tests and browser proof.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed batch
options.body: Land an intentional fixed-limit mitigation only if maintainers also align the render cap and accept that sessions above the new cap remain bounded.

options.title: Let the broader pagination PR own it
options.body: Route this through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87111 if maintainers want the wider Gateway/WebChat cursor contract instead of a narrow UI-only change.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this issue only after Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand with tests and browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the Control UI/Gateway chat-history implementation is the recent large chat surface commit by this contributor.
